summary_1line: Pandavas arrive disguised in Panchala as Drupada announces Draupadi’s swayamvara with a nearly impossible archery challenge attracting kings and sages.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a vast decorated amphitheatre, Dhrishtadyumna holds Draupadi’s arm while announcing the archery challenge before assembled kings.
The Pandavas disguised as Brahmanas sit quietly among priests while countless jeweled monarchs watch the swayamvara arena.
High above the arena a rotating target is fixed to a skyward machine while a massive bow and five arrows lie before the contestants.
